title: The AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator: A Framework to Support Technical Assessment in AI Regulatory Sandboxes
abstract: arXiv:2610.01539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The EU's Artificial Intelligence Act requires all Member States to establish AI Regulatory Sandboxes (AIRS) by August 2027: supervised environments bringing together national Competent Authorities, technical experts, and the organisations under assessment. When AIRS engagements include structured technical testing, running such testing at scale demands dedicated infrastructure, yet the tooling ecosystem remains structurally fragmented, with heterogeneous tools producing outputs that are difficult to compare, trace, and reuse. From the procedural conditions of AIRS engagements and the AI Act obligations for high-risk systems, we derive 11 architectural and governance requirements for the infrastructure that operationalises technical testing within an AIRS. translated_title: AI评估沙盒配置器：支持AI监管沙盒中技术评估的框架
translated_abstract: 欧盟《人工智能法案》要求所有成员国在2027年8月前建立人工智能监管沙盒（AIRS）：这是一种受监督的环境，将国家主管当局、技术专家与接受评估的组织聚集在一起。当AIRS的参与涉及结构化技术测试时，大规模开展此类测试需要专门的基础设施，然而现有的工具生态系统在结构上仍呈现碎片化，异构工具产生的输出难以比较、追踪和复用。基于AIRS参与的程序性条件以及《人工智能法案》对高风险系统的义务要求，本文为在AIRS内实施技术测试的基础设施推导出了11项架构与治理要求。为响应这些要求，本文提出了AI评估沙盒配置器，这是一个开源框架，结合了一个精选的测试与控制目录，可通过……
tldr: 本文针对AI监管沙盒中技术测试工具碎片化、输出难以比较和复用的问题，从AIRS程序条件和《人工智能法案》义务中推导出11项架构与治理要求，并据此提出了开源框架AI评估沙盒配置器，以支持大规模、可比较的技术评估。
en_tdlr: The paper derives 11 architectural and governance requirements from AIRS procedural conditions and AI Act obligations, and introduces the open-source AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator to overcome the fragmented tooling ecosystem and enable scalable, comparable technical testing within AI Regulatory Sandboxes.
